sections.title: The AI Challenges Facing Canadian Organizations
sections.intro: Artificial intelligence is moving fast inside your organization, usually faster than the rules meant to govern it. Simply starting this conversation puts you ahead of competitors who haven't.

featured.title: Blind spots that start to cost you
featured.text: Adoption happens in pockets: tools pile up, use cases scatter, and decisions lack direction. As the requests keep coming, the blind spots add up — scattered initiatives that are hard to prioritize and rarely tied to business goals, little visibility into your teams’ current use of AI, a rising tide of tool and licence requests with no way to vet or approve them, real questions about privacy, reliability, and accountability, expectations that blur the line between quick wins and lasting change, and governance you need to define before you invest further.

aside.title: Your people already know AI
aside.text: They have tried the tools and folded generative AI into their day-to-day. The real work isn’t overcoming resistance but turning that momentum into tangible results and building your approach around the value it creates.

sections.title: Why Choose Victrix for Your Artificial Intelligence Consulting

sections.title: The AI Opportunity for Canadian Organizations
paragraphs: There is still a wide gap between experimenting with AI, exploring opportunities and actually deploying it with method. That gap is where the value is won, and where our artificial intelligence consulting service makes the difference.
78% of businesses that haven’t adopted AI don’t yet see how it would improve their products or services. Source: Canada's National Artificial Intelligence Strategy

60%: target AI adoption among Canadian organizations by 2034, up from 12% today. 1 in 8: enterprises have formally adopted AI, yet nearly half of executives have already tried it. $187B: projected yearly contribution of generative AI to the Canadian economy by 2030. +3% of GDP: the productivity upside AI could unlock, roughly $200B. Source: Canada’s National Artificial Intelligence Strategy, “AI for All,” Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED), 2026

Adoption is also very uneven by sector: IT, professional services, and finance top 30% usage, while agriculture, transportation, and accommodation sit below 2%. Source: Responsible Integration of Artificial Intelligence in the Workplace, Quebec Ministry of Labour, 2026, based on Statistics Canada data (2025)
A scalable base for your next phases. Our AI consulting service lays a solid base you can build on at your own pace. Depending on your priorities, we can scope and price these separately:

• Microsoft Copilot: adoption, governance, training, and getting more from everyday use
  • Cybersecurity: protection, compliance, risk management, and data oversight
  • Data and analytics: preparing, cleaning, integrating, and accessing the right data
  • CRM and processes: streamlining operations and customer-facing workflows
  • Cloud and infrastructure: architecture, the technology stack, and room to scale
  • Managed services: ongoing support, operations, and continuous improvement through our managed IT services

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions About AI Consulting

items.question: What is strategic artificial intelligence consulting?
items.answer: Strategic AI consulting is a structured approach that helps your organization govern and deliver its move into AI. It starts with your business needs, prioritizes high-value initiatives, and moves the right projects forward with the right expertise.

items.question: How is this different from buying a tool like Microsoft Copilot?
items.answer: It starts with the need, not the tool. We work from the use case, then pick the approach most likely to succeed. The tool supports the strategy; it doesn't set it.

items.question: How long does the engagement last?
items.answer: Typically about 12 months, in stages. We confirm the timeline after the analysis, since it depends on your scope, your processes, and your priorities.

items.question: Are AI licences and usage credits included?
items.answer: No. The engagement covers advisory, AI strategy, and delivery. Licences and usage credits are separate subscriptions, and we can help you assess what you need.

items.question: We already have an AI committee. What is Victrix's role?
items.answer: Victrix is the specialized partner that brings perspective, speed, and a big-picture view. We don't decide for you; we help you structure the work and reach measurable gains.

items.question: How do you handle security and compliance?
items.answer: AI remains bound by the laws that already apply, including Canadian privacy laws such as Quebec's Law 25. Our cybersecurity and infrastructure DNA lets us govern how AI is used, protect your data, and keep people at the heart of every decision. We build on the recognized principles of responsible AI: respect for rights and freedoms, privacy protection and data governance, governance and social dialogue, human oversight and transparency, sustainable development.

items.question: What is the required investment?
items.answer: We take it step by step: a master plan first, then a few high-value initiatives. From there, the pace follows your resources and priorities.

items.question: Does Victrix's AI consulting adapt to my industry?
items.answer: Our strategic, applied artificial intelligence consulting adapts to a wide range of industries, including engineering, legal, advanced manufacturing, construction, consulting, tourism, and more. Reach out to our AI consultants to see how Victrix can help you turn your AI ambitions into reality.
